purpose.summary: Add a bounded default-protected valid-chain reorganization oracle to the public legacy-compatibility matrix without changing node or consensus code.
scope: Extend only mixed-node-coexistence with one short protected-reorganization check before pruning; retain the existing scenario and build-role inventories.

Use an isolated exact-baseline generator to create a three-block incumbent and five-block replacement from one exact common tip, then submit the same raw blocks in the same order to the disconnected baseline and candidate roles.

Require both evaluated roles to keep the replacement parked at equal work and a one-block lead, activate it at a two-block lead, retain the incumbent as a valid fork, converge on the exact chain and UTXO snapshot, and resume cross-mining.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, activation, native-asset, optional-indexing, testnet, or mainnet-parameter change.
No new scenario ID, build role, inherited functional-test selection, or evidence promotion.
No P2P reorganization-propagation, invalid-branch, transaction-conflict, mempool, variable-depth, pruned-history, interruption, crash, public-network, or mainnet claim.
No private source, history, operator material, host metadata, binary, or incoming evidence.

files.test_reachability: Documents the governed restart, reconstruction, protected-reorg, and physical-pruning lifecycle contract.
Exercises honest two-role coexistence, clean restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, one bounded default-protected valid-chain reorganization, and manual physical pruning.
Runs the identity-bound fail-closed public matrix and requires all reviewed lifecycle markers.
Covers runner contracts, reconstruction, protected-reorg and physical-pruning canaries, record binding, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public protected-reorg harness with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed legacy/candidate coexistence, restart, reconstruction, default-protected-reorganization, and physical-pruning scenario.
expected_results: Alternating mining and clean same-datadir restart preserve exact chain, UTXO commitment, and raw-tip projections.
Full reindex and chainstate-only reindex on both roles emit fresh lifecycle markers, restore the exact pre-rebuild snapshot, and accept one new block mined by each role.

Before pruning, an isolated exact-baseline generator builds one three-block incumbent and five-block replacement from the same common tip; both evaluated roles receive identical raw blocks, keep the replacement parked at equal work and a one-block lead, activate it at a two-block lead, retain the incumbent as a valid fork, converge exactly, and resume cross-mining.

Only after the protected-reorganization check, both roles restart their unchanged datadir directories in manual-pruning mode, accept identical baseline-template-bound large blocks, physically remove the first block and undo file pair, agree on a bounded readable prune height, preserve the exact tip and UTXO state across same-datadir restart, and accept post-prune mining by each role.
failure_conditions: Any process, generator isolation, common parent, raw-block ordering or acceptance, chainwork threshold, branch status, active tip, lifecycle marker, physical file, prune mode, chain, UTXO, raw tip, restart, mining, cleanup, or identity divergence fails closed.

limitations: No public candidate execution evidence exists for ERGON-CHANGE-0009; any later successful public promotion remains capped at Observed / assembled_component.

The new oracle covers one short valid coinbase-only replacement on local regtest: a three-block incumbent, parking at equal work and a one-block lead, and activation at a two-block lead under the default policy.

Blocks are replayed through RPC to disconnected evaluated roles; P2P reorganization propagation, variable depths, invalid branches, transaction and mempool conflicts, DAA transitions, restart or crash during reorganization, and reorganization across pruned history remain untested.

The normalized report will not serialize raw logs, physical paths, or per-role branch measurements; those oracles are enforced by the exact signed scenario and will not be independently recomputable from the report alone.
Historical-chain replay, sustained operation, public-network peers, and mainnet remain untested.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality, and the dependency profile is not locked.
Operator-binary equivalence and mainnet coexistence remain unproved.
This initial record carries no execution evidence and is not an independent reproduction pack.
counterevidence: ERGON-CHANGE-0007 public evidence observes restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, and manual physical pruning, but it contains no competing-branch reorganization oracle.

An unpublished r1 draft stopped during the long pruning-boundary block burst after its single one-way evaluated-role P2P connection closed, leaving the baseline and candidate at different heights without an observed consensus disagreement. The r2 correction makes every evaluated-role connection bidirectional and adds an exact topology canary; this private diagnostic is not public execution evidence.
The private focused smoke cannot promote public evidence and is excluded from the public record.
A future pass of this short oracle cannot establish deep, pruned-history, invalid-branch, transaction-conflict, P2P, DAA, public-network, operator-binary, or mainnet behavior.
